verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev tasks are plain async functions that can be triggered from elsewhere in code. `triggerAndWait()` runs another task and returns its result data to continue with, which effectively makes tasks reusable sub-workflows that other workflows call. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parent/child task composition (e.g. calling triggerAndWait from inside another task), any visual or module-library composition, and independent hands-on corroboration of sub-task reuse.
